frontier_updates.reason: Only candidate available; bootstrap with valid reward code but target behavior gap (0% success, 100% unsafe). Needs revision to increase success signal and reduce unsafe terminations.

expert_search_strategy_decision.next_search_hypothesis: Increase the success_bonus magnitude and tighten its conditions to provide a stronger sparse signal for true safe landing. Reduce the crash_penalty magnitude to avoid overwhelming exploration, and add a small penalty for high vertical speed near ground to discourage hard landings. The goal is to shift behavior from 100% unsafe terminal to at least partial success-like terminal outcomes.
expert_search_strategy_decision.strategy_rationale: Only one bootstrap candidate exists. It has valid reward code and passes static validation, but behavior is entirely unsafe (100% unsafe terminal, 0% success). The fitness score is very negative (-117.9) with high uncertainty (SEM 4.66, only 5 eval episodes). The reward schema includes a success_bonus of 100.0 but the conditions are strict (both legs contact, angle<0.1, x<0.1, y<0.1, vx<0.1, vy<0.1) and the crash_penalty is -100.0. The shaping reward is negative distance and vertical speed, which may encourage hovering. The leg_contact_bonus of 10.0 may reward landing off-pad. The next hypothesis is to strengthen the success signal and adjust penalties to avoid overwhelming the agent with negative feedback. Since this is the first iteration, no negative edges exist.
